steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow the named vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ with whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Set the requested delivery location on the product row.
Search for and add the specifically named vendor during creation.
Verify the named vendor appears in the creation screen's participant area.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Open the published stage's Participants tab.
Verify that exactly one vendor is a participant.
Verify the sole participant is the named vendor and is selected for the round.
